metadata.title: AHMEDABAD  Old City Food Tour and HUGE Gujarati THALI | Part - 4/4 I Gujarat Food Tour
metadata.description:
In this last episode of Ahmedabad Food Tour, Piyush and I went on a full on street food tour in the walled city trying the authentic Gujrati breakfast at Chandravilas, moving on to the lane of sweet makers and ending with gujarati snacks- khaman and Panki. 

The food journey in Ahmedabad ended with a huge Vegetarian Gujarati thali at Vishala. 
Make sure to watch this video till end to enjoy the food ride with DFW!


About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
